title: Modal dialog prevention (issue #36)
description: The Windows modal dialog that blocked app startup.
body: CreateProcess handed a file beginning with MZ but having no PE header puts up a modal 'Unsupported 16-Bit Application' box and blocks the calling thread. The launch terminal is spawned synchronously while the splash is the only window on screen. A shell on PATH that fails this check could appear as if the application never starts until a box is dismissed. Reading the PE header before spawning prevents this.
